Ditio._comment: Copy this file to appsettings.json and fill in ClientId/ClientSecret/CompanyId. appsettings.json is git-ignored. Defaults below are PRODUCTION; the test values are in comments.

ChkBox._comment: Only needed for example 11 (crew list -> Infotech ChkBox). The ApiKey belongs to the project owner (byggherre) and is issued by Infotech - never commit it. Defaults below are the DEVELOPMENT/TESTING api; production is https://api.byggekortleser.no with a different key.
ChkBox._Source: crew-list-registrations (public data-extraction endpoint, recommended) | online-users (legacy backoffice crew list)
ChkBox._BackfillHours: 0 = today only, matching the crew list's own default. Raise once for a backfill, then set back.
ChkBox._Projects: Map each Ditio project to the ChkBox project id the project owner gave you. Only mapped projects are bridged.
